name: shader-mesh-gradient-dusk
title: Shader Mesh Gradient Dusk
description: Violet dusk with coral and peach light drifting through deep indigo. A WebGL shader backdrop; the dusk preset of shader-mesh-gradient.
useWhen: An evening, end-of-day mood behind a launch title or a closing card.
Foreground is light text or a bright product shot that needs a dark field around it.
You want a finished Mesh Gradient look without tuning the palette and parameters yourself.
avoidWhen: The video must use your brand colors: start from `shader-mesh-gradient` and set `colors`.
You want a lighter, contrasting mood from the same shader: use `shader-mesh-gradient-peach`.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 10 colors, comma separated, that blend into the gradient.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast the colors drift. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Distortion
variables.description: How much the color shapes bend.

variables.label: Swirl
variables.description: How much the colors twist around the center.

variables.label: Grain in the blend
variables.description: Grain that roughens the edges between colors.

variables.label: Grain overlay
variables.description: Film-like grain over the whole gradient.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the gradient in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; a soft gradient looks the same at 0.5.
